_note: Phase 7 remediation (E12) regression set, written and committed BEFORE the escalation routing code existed. It was written knowing the failure mode, so it is a regression check, not an unbiased test. expected_route: the metadata topic the query should be restricted to, or null for plain dense retrieval. relevant_doc_ids: the top-1 retrieved document must be one of these, in both collections.
